      public TaJobService(String csvPath)
      Creates a job service using the supplied CSV path.
      参数:
      csvPath - path to job.csv; when blank, a default project-relative path is used

  • 方法详细资料

    • getAllJobs

      public List<JobPosting> getAllJobs()
      Loads all job postings from the configured CSV file.
      返回:
      list of parsed job postings, or an empty list when the file is missing or cannot be read

    • searchJobs

      public List<JobPosting> searchJobs(String subject, String workType, String status, String keyword)
      Searches jobs using optional subject, work type, status, and keyword filters. All non-empty filters must match for a job to be included.
      参数:
      subject - exact subject filter, or blank for all subjects
      workType - exact work type filter, or blank for all types
      status - exact status filter, or blank for all statuses
      keyword - keyword matched against job text fields, or blank for no keyword
      返回:
      filtered job postings
